title: Tiny, cute glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left lens -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='50' r='18' fill='#33ddff' opacity='0.35' stroke='#88eeff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- Right lens -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='50' r='18' fill='#33ddff' opacity='0.35' stroke='#88eeff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- Bridge -->
  <path d='M50 46 Q50 40 58 42 Q62 43 62 46' fill='none' stroke='#88eeff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 46 Q50 40 42 42 Q38 43 38 46' fill='none' stroke='#88eeff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <line x1='14' y1='48' x2='2' y2='38' stroke='#88eeff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <line x1='86' y1='48' x2='98' y2='38' stroke='#88eeff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Lens highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='42' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='42' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Cute little eyes behind lenses -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='52' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='52' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#112244'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='52' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='52' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#112244'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='36' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='62' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
